blocks.title: Sequence diagram
blocks.text: Sequence diagrams dikhate hain ke nizam ke objects ek khaas tarteeb mein aapas mein kaise taamul karte hain. Yeh waqt ke saath objects ke darmiyan paighamat ka bahao samajhne mein madad dete hain.

Figure 1.11 kamre ki misal jaari rakhti hai. User aur teen dabbon (toys box, books box aur clothes box) ki apni amudi lifeline hai. Oopar se neeche parhe jane wale paigham yeh hain: har dabba open() karna; khilone, kitabein aur kapre apne dabbon mein daalna; phir har dabba close() karna.

blocks.alt: Chaar lifelines, User, Toys Box, Books Box aur Clothes Box, tooti hui (dashed) lakeeron ki soorat neeche jati hain. Teer tarteeb se User se dabbon ki taraf jate hain: har dabbe ko open(), put toys inside, put books inside aur put clothes inside, phir har dabbe ko close().
blocks.caption: Figure 1.11: User ka cheezein label wale dabbon mein rakhne ka sequence diagram (kitab ki Figure 1.11 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Sequence diagram oopar se neeche waqt ki tarteeb mein parha jata hai, aur teer paigham bhejne wale se paigham lene wale ki taraf jata hai. Kitab ki figure mein 'put toys/books/clothes inside' ke teer ulte, yani dabbon se User ki taraf, bane hain, jab ke kitab ka apna matan (text) kehta hai ke User cheezein dabbon mein daalta hai. Is liye yahan yeh teer User se dabbon ki taraf banaye gaye hain, jo durust hai. Kitab mein aakhri close() teer lifelines khatam hone ke baad bana hai; yahan lifelines aakhri paigham tak barhai gayi hain.

blocks.prompt: Long question 5: food delivery app mein items chunne se delivery tak order dene ka sequence diagram bayan kijiye.
blocks.explanation: Lifelines: customer, app, restaurant, payment service, rider. Tarteeb se paigham: customer items chun kar order deta hai; app payment service ko payment ki darkhwast bhej kar tasdeeq leti hai; app order restaurant ko bhejti hai, jo manzoor kar ke khana tayyar karta hai; app rider muqarrar karti hai; restaurant app ko batata hai ke khana tayyar hai; rider utha kar deliver karta hai; app customer ko batati hai ke order pohanch gaya.

items: Sequence diagram: lifelines wale objects aur waqt ki tarteeb mein paigham (Fig. 1.11: har dabba open, andar daalna, close).
